didymosDocument.printedConflict: Cover names Dimorphos; page4 introduction describes Didymos primary and a DRACO/LUKE shape. Page8 prose names Didymos but opening sentence and Table2 heading name Dimorphos; table explicitly names DIDYMOS-MODEL-v003.
didymosDocument.limits: The printed c value is retained without decimal repair or physical-shape adoption. Mixed body wording and intended corrections remain unresolved. This PDF is not byte-identical to the separately served Dimorphos v2 PDF.

dimorphosV2Document.page4: Secondary-only introduction; v2 supersedes preliminary v1. Sub-primary direction was shadowed/unobserved at encounter; a visible anchor is assigned a longitude consistent with the primary direction.
dimorphosV2Document.page8: Table2 explicitly identifies DIMORPHOS-MODEL-v004. ICRF pole/rotation convention uses J2000 JD2451545.0 TDB; acceleration term assumes pre-impact tidal locking, not a measured present-day postimpact spin solution.
dimorphosV2Document.limits: These are publisher model constants, not calibrated local normals, current ephemerides, a postimpact shape or a permanent observer-facing direction.
